evidence: Carries the 'Tests' label and modifies unit test harness utilities (TestChain100Setup and index teardown) to prevent race conditions and flaky test failures.
rationale: Fixes race conditions in unit test utilities that cause non-deterministic failures and intermittent TSan reports. As noted in the description, 'TestChain100Setup asynchronously enqueues 100 block validation events that can race with subscriber events in subsequent unit tests, causing non-deterministic failures,' and undrained events before stopping indexes 'would be unsafe anyway and lead to intermittent tsan error reports'.
